posts.cooked:
Hey,

I just want to know about OPPE exams. How will these exams be conducted?

I got mail about it (Grading policy for python) but understand a little. Anyone pls explain..

posts.name: BHAVEN
posts.cooked: The OPPE (Online Proctored Programming Exam) is an online exam. It is a programming exam wherein you would have to solve the programming questions in the invigilation of the proctor via camera. Further in the course you would be given GRPAs (Graded Programming Assignments), the format of the questions in the OPPE would be same as the GRPAs.
